family_distinction: Contrarian standardized-drawdown entry with recovery/time exit; no trend signal, breakout rule, momentum sign, or volatility targeting is used.
economic_hypothesis: Short-lived liquidity demand, forced selling, and asynchronous price discovery can create temporary one-to-five-session overshoots in liquid BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT spot markets. A large negative three-session return standardized only by completed-session volatility may therefore partially reverse before five causal execution intervals elapse. The hypothesis is falsified if conservative costs, delay, cross-fold, asset, parameter, regime, concentration, and statistical gates do not all pass.

session_and_information_contract.complete_session: exactly 1440 unique consecutive one-minute implied-open timestamps with finite OHLCV, event_timestamp equal to implied_open plus one minute, and available_timestamp not earlier than event_timestamp
session_and_information_contract.daily_ohlcv: first open, maximum high, minimum low, last close, and sum volume from one complete session only
session_and_information_contract.decision_time: after the completed session when every constituent event_timestamp and available_timestamp is known
session_and_information_contract.information_cutoff: maximum of the session's final event_timestamp and every constituent available_timestamp
session_and_information_contract.candidate_fill: the earliest unique minute record whose implied open timestamp is strictly greater than the information cutoff
session_and_information_contract.fill_tie_rule: records are ordered by implied_open_timestamp, event_timestamp, available_timestamp, and source_provenance; any duplicate at the selected implied open is a data-integrity failure rather than an arbitrary tie break
session_and_information_contract.signal_inputs: completed sessions ending at t only
session_and_information_contract.cross_asset_synchronization: portfolio rebalance requires a valid candidate fill for both assets at the same implied-open timestamp

primary_signal_contract.volatility_estimator: sample standard deviation with ddof=1 of exactly r_t_minus_19 through r_t
primary_signal_contract.entry_rule: if actual state is cash, no order is pending, volatility is finite and strictly positive, and z_t <= -1.5, target long at the next valid base fill
primary_signal_contract.recovery_exit_rule: if actual state is long, no order is pending, and z_t >= -0.25, target cash at the next valid base fill
primary_signal_contract.maximum_holding_rule: an entry executed at synchronized fill index j schedules a mandatory cash target at fill index j+5; the five exposed intervals are j-to-j+1 through j+4-to-j+5, and recovery may liquidate earlier
primary_signal_contract.insufficient_input_rule: when cash, insufficient, zero, or nonfinite input preserves cash; when long, it does not erase exposure and the mandatory holding clock continues

execution_and_accounting_contract.base_execution: a desired target produced at session t executes only at the synchronized candidate fill strictly after t's information cutoff
execution_and_accounting_contract.initial_state: cash with no pending order and no holding clock
execution_and_accounting_contract.simultaneous_order_priority: one portfolio target vector is formed from the two independent asset states; both legs are marked and traded atomically at the synchronized fill
execution_and_accounting_contract.drifted_pretrade_weights: mark each risky holding and cash from the prior fill to current fill prices, divide each marked component by total pretrade equity, and use zero target for an asset ordered to cash
execution_and_accounting_contract.turnover: sum over BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT of absolute target risky weight minus drifted pretrade risky weight
execution_and_accounting_contract.cost: pretrade equity times one-way total cost rate times turnover
execution_and_accounting_contract.postcost_allocation: deduct cost from pretrade equity, allocate each risky target weight against postcost equity, and retain one minus total risky target weight as nonnegative cash
execution_and_accounting_contract.insufficient_cash_or_nonpositive_equity: terminal accounting failure; do not clip, borrow, or inject capital
execution_and_accounting_contract.terminal_trade: full liquidation to cash is charged for every standalone fold, aggregate period, variant, stress, baseline, and standalone-asset evaluation
execution_and_accounting_contract.buy_and_hold: initial purchase and terminal liquidation are charged, holdings drift without rebalancing
execution_and_accounting_contract.return_interval: postcost equity immediately after one fill through pretrade equity at the next fill, with the next fill's trading cost included in the return ending there

additional_delay_contract.delay: one additional completed eligible session beyond base execution
additional_delay_contract.pending_order_rule: a decision made with no pending order is queued unchanged for the second synchronized valid daily fill after its information cutoff
additional_delay_contract.supersession_rule: later signals cannot cancel, replace, or stack with a pending order
additional_delay_contract.state_update_rule: actual long-or-cash state and entry fill index change only when the queued target executes
additional_delay_contract.decision_while_pending: no new decision or order is accepted
additional_delay_contract.holding_clock: counts actual post-entry execution intervals and schedules delayed liquidation after five actual exposed intervals
additional_delay_contract.cost_and_accounting: identical to base other than execution timing

missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.detection: any incomplete UTC session, duplicate selected fill, non-synchronized portfolio fill, or missing required execution fill
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.cash_at_detection: remain cash, exclude affected boundary intervals, clear pending decisions, and require 150 consecutive complete synchronized sessions before new decisions
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.risky_exposure_at_detection: terminal DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE because exposure and self-financing PnL may not be silently erased, imputed, or reset
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.pending_entry_at_detection: cancel only if actual exposure is still cash, then apply the 150-session recovery
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.pending_exit_or_risky_pending_target_at_: terminal DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE because actual risky exposure remains economically live
missing_data_and_quarantine_contract.recovery_state: cash, no order, no holding clock, and indicators rebuilt entirely from the 150 complete recovery sessions

walk_forward_contract.fold_boundary: half-open start inclusive and end exclusive
walk_forward_contract.warmup: pre-fold completed sessions may initialize rolling indicators only; positions, pending orders, holding clocks, equity, costs, and PnL never carry into a fold
walk_forward_contract.first_decision: only after the first completed session whose session start is at or after the fold start; its next fill must be inside the fold
walk_forward_contract.interval_assignment: the interval's starting fill is at or after fold start and its ending fill is strictly before fold end
walk_forward_contract.forced_terminal_liquidation: at the final synchronized valid fill strictly before fold end, using an ex-ante forced cash target declared at the immediately preceding eligible decision regardless of signal
walk_forward_contract.terminal_interval: included only when both liquidation fill and interval start satisfy the fold boundary
walk_forward_contract.aggregate_period: evaluated separately from cash over the full development or holdout window with its own initial and terminal costs
walk_forward_contract.purging_and_embargo: not applicable to fixed completed-session rules; no return interval crosses a fold boundary

raw_three_session_drawdown_baseline.entry: cash to long when close_t / close_t_minus_3 - 1 <= -0.05
raw_three_session_drawdown_baseline.exit: long to cash when r_t > 0 or at mandatory fill j+5
raw_three_session_drawdown_baseline.accounting: identical weights, state, execution, gaps, folds, costs, and terminal liquidation

benchmarks_and_variants.selection_rule: primary_standardized_shock is fixed and can never be replaced by a variant

trade_and_sensitivity_contract.completed_entry: one asset transition from actual cash to actual long at a fill followed by an actual costed transition back to cash inside the same evaluation boundary
trade_and_sensitivity_contract.standalone_asset: run identical signal, holding clock, execution, costs, gaps, folds, statistics, and terminal liquidation with the named asset target allowed zero or one and all residual in cash
trade_and_sensitivity_contract.asset_gate: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT standalone aggregate net returns must each be strictly positive

statistical_contract.daily_return_series: all valid base execution intervals including genuine cash zero returns; quarantined and boundary-crossing intervals are absent, never zero-filled
statistical_contract.sharpe: mean daily net return divided by sample standard deviation ddof=1 times sqrt(365), risk-free zero
statistical_contract.sharpe_degenerate_rule: fewer than two returns, zero standard deviation, or nonfinite input fails the Sharpe gate

bootstrap.seed: unsigned first 64 bits of SHA256 UTF-8 experiment_id
bootstrap.confidence_interval: two-sided percentile with NumPy linear interpolation at 0.025 and 0.975
bootstrap.degenerate_rule: fewer than two observations or nonfinite result fails

deflated_sharpe_ratio.observed_daily_sharpe: primary mean divided by sample standard deviation ddof=1
deflated_sharpe_ratio.alternative_daily_sharpes: seven trials on the exact intersection of causal interval timestamps
deflated_sharpe_ratio.benchmark_SR0: sample standard deviation ddof=1 of seven alternative daily Sharpes times ((1-Euler_gamma)*Phi_inverse(1-1/7)+Euler_gamma*Phi_inverse(1-1/(7*e)))
deflated_sharpe_ratio.dependence_adjustment: none, treating seven trials as independent for conservative maximum multiplicity penalty
deflated_sharpe_ratio.degenerate_rule: T below three, nonfinite input, zero primary standard deviation, negative denominator, or undefined alternative Sharpe yields probability zero

probability_of_backtest_overfitting.inputs: seven trial returns on exact common causal timestamps
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.zero_volatility_sharpe: negative infinity unless mean is strictly positive, then positive infinity
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.out_of_sample_rank: average rank from worst one to best seven
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.degenerate_rule: fewer than eight common observations, empty block, or nonfinite rank input fails with PBO one

exceptional_concentration.scope: aggregate portfolio and each standalone asset daily net PnL series
exceptional_concentration.denominator: sum of strictly positive daily net PnL

regime_contract.assignment_time: causal execution interval start from only the preceding completed BTC signal session
regime_contract.trend_axis: close_signal_session / close_120_sessions_prior - 1 strictly positive is up, otherwise down
regime_contract.volatility_axis: 60-session sample standard deviation of simple BTC returns ending at signal session strictly above expanding median of prior eligible 60-session volatility estimates is high, otherwise low
regime_contract.eligibility: both interval and completed-entry minima must pass
regime_contract.development_gate: at least three regimes eligible; every eligible regime strictly positive net; no eligible regime below minus five percent net return

development_gates_all_required.baseline_superiority: primary Sharpe strictly above both equal-weight buy-and-hold and raw-drawdown-baseline Sharpes, and primary maximum drawdown strictly below both comparators' maximum drawdowns

holdout_contract.open_rule: reused data contract remains PASS, every development gate passes, source checkpoint is clean and committed, and a separate live Sol/xhigh pre-holdout audit returns HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED
holdout_contract.one_shot: after approval, create a hash-committed access record before parsing any holdout footer or value; exactly one evaluation invocation is permitted
holdout_contract.failure_rule: any read, schema, execution, accounting, or evaluator failure after first holdout access is terminal HOLDOUT_EVALUATION_FAILURE with no repair, rerun, or reopen
holdout_contract.immutability: primary, variants, data, code, costs, signal, state, execution, accounting, statistics, gates, and seeds cannot change after approval
holdout_contract.other_gates: every other development numerical, comparison, stress, parameter, asset, bootstrap, DSR, PBO, regime, concentration, leakage, and drawdown gate applies unchanged

promotion_and_prospective_contract.historical_candidate_freeze: only after all holdout gates and a separate live Sol/xhigh terminal audit pass
promotion_and_prospective_contract.prospective_data: must arrive strictly after the candidate freeze timestamp
promotion_and_prospective_contract.independent_asset_decision: one frozen desired-exposure computation for one asset after each eligible completed UTC session whether or not target changes; at most two count per session
promotion_and_prospective_contract.accounting: identical frozen signal, holding, execution, cost, gap, and self-financing rules; no refit or gate change
